ops.entry: WHEN a contract or characterization keys on producer outcomes DO inventory success-field shapes as well as failure causes. Trace null, empty, omitted, and wrong-type values through producer normalization before predicting consumer behavior.
ops.why: CR1 accepted: the cause matrix appeared complete but omitted a successful row that reached an unintended fallback. P-08 traces scope and sources and P-07 compares predicates after refactoring; neither asks for this inventory at plan time. Patterns was full (15/15); this check applies more broadly than the guarded-import exception-ownership rule it displaces.

originals.original: WHEN multiple consumers handle one guarded dependency DO keep the dependency’s exception policy in its owning module and expose that contract to consumers — importing the dependency at every consumer duplicates policy and can violate guarded-import locks.

ops.entry: WHEN reviewing a consumer of inflight_registry.py's find_run_claim DO expect an omitted feature to pass the feature-validity check as LEGACY_FEATURE, not be refused. An explicit null, empty string, or non-string reaches the consumer unchanged and must fail that check.
ops.why: CR2 accepted: find_run_claim defaults only a missing key; a consumer review would otherwise conflate valid legacy placement with malformed stored values. Narrowed the candidate to the verified read interface: the cited falsy normalization is in release_cmd, not the claim writer.
